David Attenborough: songs of life
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough selects seven of the most extraordinary recordings from the natural world and explores what these sounds mean to specific animal species. Each song - from that of a lemur, through the song of a humpback whale or a lyrebird from the order of passerine birds - was recorded during the lifetime of a famous naturalist who recorded and analyzed these songs for decades. The oldest recording was made when Sir David was five years old, the latest just a few years before the documentary was created. Each has an amazing story behind it and shows how much we still don't know about the natural world. When Sir David Attenborough was born, the science of song was transformed under Charles Darwin's theory of sexual selection, which labeled singing dangerous because it revealed the singer's location to predators. The same song also gives males a great chance to be noticed by the female and thus to pass on their genes to the next generation of birds. So the males sing, and the females listen and choose the best singers because, according to them, they will be the best fathers. New scientific trends in bird song are challenging these long-held ideas. Scientists invited to the program show that in fact, in most species of songbirds, females create their own songs - and only now do they have a chance to be truly heard. However, there is a concern whether we will be able to learn all the songs of these extraordinary birds - the human loss is loud, and the planet Earth is falling silently, as the host of the program also warns. The production is a continuation of the documentary film nominated for the Grierson Award. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.desc: «LALIGA VS (24/25) (1): Fernando Morientes and Sergio Cunningham» Laurie Cunningham, the first black footballer to play for the English national team, came to Spanish professional football in 1979 becoming an icon of the anti-racist fight. His son Sergio remembers his relevant figure in a conversation with another illustrious Real Madrid striker, Fernando Morientes. Both review how racism was experienced in the last decades of the 20th century in the second video podcast of LALIGA VS, a project to transform society through football and eradicate hatred inside and outside the stadiums.

programme.desc: Agents in Miami make a controlled delivery of 142 kilograms of cocaine that were hidden in a shipment of avocados. Several agencies are investigating human trafficking at the Texas border and find 16 migrants hiding illegally. Cast: Denise Toto, Jim Finn. USA, 2012, crime

programme.title: d/s Catch a smuggler: Kennedy Airport. Methamphetamine Mountain
programme.desc: Customs officials in Miami find six sacred Akwansha monoliths illegally smuggled from Nigeria. Travelers flock to Detroit for a music festival to buy drugs and weapons. Cast: Denise Toto, Jim Finn. USA, 2012, crime

programme.title: d/s Catch a smuggler: Kennedy Airport. Drug network on the dark internet
programme.desc: Agents in Denver track a shipment of ecstasy to France and work with local law enforcement to uncover $8 million in drug smuggling via the dark internet. Cast: Denise Toto, Jim Finn. USA, 2012, crime

programme.title: d/s Survival in the northern forests. Breath of Spring
programme.desc: Margot leaves her hunting trail for a while to prepare for the next summer hunting season, now on horseback. Matty, who is “forging” his next project in the wilderness, is in for serious changes. USA

programme.title: d/s Survival in the northern forests. Summer mood
programme.desc: With warmer weather approaching, Margot and Alex saddle up their horses to begin their summer season. Billy gives his newly renovated boat a tough test on the mighty St. Lawrence River. USA

programme.title: d/s Yukon Rescuers. At the limit
programme.desc: Avalanche workers rush to repair a remote weather station before an approaching storm. Increasing risks force them to carry out a snow dumping operation to eliminate the dangerous snow “canopy” over the Klondike highway

programme.title: d/s Air crash investigations. Complete engine failure
programme.desc: When the engine of the BMA plane caught fire, the pilots tried to make an emergency landing, but the second engine also failed. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003-present documentary

programme.title: d/s Air crash investigations. Chaos in the cockpit
programme.desc: Northwest Airlines Flight 255 crashes on takeoff. This plane crash was the second deadliest crash in US history. Could this tragedy have been avoided? Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003-present documentary

programme.title: d/s Air crash investigations. Approach to Kathmandu
programme.desc: After a routine landing, a Taiwanese local plane is suddenly rocked by a powerful explosion that completely destroys its fuselage. An international team of investigators finds no evidence of a bomb exploding on board, but as experts dig through the wreckage of the plane, they eventually find what caused the crash in the overhead bins of the plane's cabin. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003-present documentary

programme.title: d/f The Last Secret of Cleopatra
programme.desc: Archaeologist Kathleen Martinez leads a thrilling investigation on land and under water to find the missing pieces of the puzzle that may reveal Cleopatra's final days. Using the latest technology and the unrivaled skill of researcher Bob Ballard, she sets her sights on one of the greatest archaeological discoveries of the century - the tomb of Cleopatra. Cast: Kathleen Martinez. UK, 2024

programme.title: d/f Rome underground
programme.desc: The program immerses viewers in a fascinating exploration of Rome, combining the epic history of the metro's construction with fascinating archaeological finds. The documentary reveals how the construction of a 26-kilometer metro line through the historic center of the Eternal City led to the most important discoveries of the modern era

programme.title: d/s Ice Road. Road Closed!
programme.desc: Bjorn and Tord work together to save a Swedish truck that has slid into a ditch just 200 meters from its destination. It carries tons of steel, and any misstep could result in disaster if it rolls down the slope. Dir.: Kelly Neal, Kabe Sponberg, Meidell Olsen. Cast: Thord Paulsen, David Wartnaby, Bjørn Lægreid, Jo Roger Blengsli, J.Olah, William J O'Donnell, Jeff O.Collins, Olicer J Muñoz, Peter J.Oravec, Offen M.J. USA, Norway, 2015

programme.title: d/s Ice Road. Towards danger
programme.desc: The truck gets caught in a snowdrift in the mountains, Tord and newcomer Terje have to risk their lives to save the valuable cargo. Dir.: Kelly Neal, Kabe Sponberg, Meidell Olsen. Cast: Thord Paulsen, David Wartnaby, Bjørn Lægreid, Jo Roger Blengsli, J.Olah, William J O'Donnell, Jeff O.Collins, Olicer J Muñoz, Peter J.Oravec, Offen M.J. USA, Norway, 2015

programme.title: d/s Yukon Rescuers. At the limit
programme.desc: Avalanche workers rush to repair a remote weather station before an approaching storm. Increasing risks force them to carry out a snow dumping operation to eliminate the dangerous snow “canopy” over the Klondike highway

programme.title: d/s Yukon Rescuers. Hunting
programme.desc: Yukon Civil Air Search and Rescue Association battles dangerous flying conditions as it investigates the disappearance of a historic aircraft

programme.title: d/s Chernobyl: At the epicenter of the disaster. Inferno
programme.desc: At 1:23 a.m. on April 26, 1986, a powerful explosion rocked reactor four at the Chernobyl nuclear power plant in Soviet Ukraine.

programme.title: d/s Chernobyl: At the epicenter of the disaster. Concealment
programme.desc: On April 28, a fire is still raging in the remains of reactor No. 4. Helicopters trying to extinguish it are exposed to huge doses of radiation

programme.title: d/s Chernobyl: At the epicenter of the disaster. Sacrifice
programme.desc: Two weeks after the explosion, Soviet authorities are rushing to prevent the molten nuclear core from poisoning groundwater and clear the 30-kilometer exclusion zone of deadly radioactive fallout.

programme.title: d/s Chernobyl: At the epicenter of the disaster. Precipitation
programme.desc: More than a year after the accident, the plant operators accused of causing it were put on trial in a Soviet show trial. Nearly 200 tons of deadly radioactive nuclear fuel went missing inside the power plant.

programme.title: d/s Seconds until disaster. Fukushima
programme.desc: In March 2011, Japan suffered the most powerful earthquake in its history. A 14-meter tsunami hits the Fukushima nuclear power plant, knocking out its external power supply and cooling systems, causing the core reactors to melt. Due to overheating, two huge explosions occurred, which destroyed the station and led to the spread of radiation. That day, Japan faced its worst accident since Chernobyl. An international nuclear expert will thoroughly analyze this case and tell us whether this tragedy could have been prevented. UK, 2004

programme.title: d/s Seconds until disaster. Nagasaki: The Forgotten Bomb
programme.desc: We will examine the controversial claims that the dropping of the atomic bomb on Nagasaki was necessary to bring World War II to a speedy end. Cast: Ashton Smith, Richard Vaughan, Peter Guinness. UK, 2004

programme.title: d/s Seconds until disaster. Space shuttle Challenger
programme.desc: Incredible excitement surrounded the launch of the space shuttle Challenger in 1986 from Kennedy Space Center in Florida, USA. This event was to be remembered as the first civilian flight into space. On January 28, 1986, everyone watched with anticipation as schoolteacher Christa McAuliffe prepared to become the first civilian astronaut. At 11:38 the shuttle launches and it rushes into the atmosphere. But 73 seconds later, the entire nation watched a terrible scene: the shuttle suddenly burst into flames and disintegrated in the sky. NASA launched a full-scale investigation into the incident, trying to find an answer to the main question: whether this tragedy could have been prevented. Cast: Ashton Smith, Richard Vaughan, Peter Guinness. UK, 2004

programme.title: d/s Life Below Zero: Port Protection. Let the construction begin
programme.desc: Residents of Port Protection must work tirelessly to maintain their place in the harsh wilderness. Sam and his son Matt help their new neighbor Troy lay the foundation for the cabin. Curley sets out on a journey in hopes of getting some crabs. USA, 2020

programme.title: д/с Life Below Zero: Port Protection. Рыба-зомби
programme.desc: Residents of Port Protection are quickly preparing for a brutal and merciless winter. Skibb helps Troy take the next step towards building his own cabin. Oliver and Breanna want to try duck. Sam restores a stove he picked up from a junkyard. USA, 2020

programme.title: The secret world of snakes. 3 s. Asia and Europe
Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs: The Rescuers (S1E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2019. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S1, Ep1 «Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs»…In this episode, dogs are coming to our rescue in a number of surprising ways. A Great Dane shows us how he has transformed the life of a 13-year-old Massachusetts girl with a life-limiting condition. A Search and Rescue Border Collie-cross – was once on death row in an animal shelter but now he's an integral member of the California Task Force searching for survivors when earthquakes, hurricanes or deadly mudslides strike. Ruger the anti-poaching dog is on duty in Zambia detecting illegal ivory and smuggled wildlife. And, finally, A Newfoundland helps teach his German Shepherd apprentice she needs to become a water rescue dog in Italy's Lake Garda | It is often said that dogs are man's best friend but this documentary shows that they can also make excellent colleagues too. This series looks at the ways that the natural attributes of canines are being used in the world of work in all different sectors and how dogs are used to enhance and sometimes save the lives of humans. Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs travels across different continents to meet the four-legged friends who are performing key roles in crucial work. We see how dogs are integral to the work of the police, firefighters, scientists and more. Narrated by Victoria Stilwell | Director: Blake McGrow, Sean McDonnell

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs: The Lifesavers (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2019. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S1, Ep2 «Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs»…Across the world, dogs are saving lives. At a South African airport, bird-chasing Border Collies are preventing potentially devastating collisions with aircraft. programme.title: Baby Animals: Joined At the Hip (S2E4). Documentary about nature. USA, 2015. S2, Ep4
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: JAV. Год: 2015. S2, Ep4 «Baby Animals»…The animal kingdom can be a harsh place, but some baby animals have a family ready to take care of their needs. Meet some of these adorable babies and their clans: a koala joey, European elk twins, a litter of Asian short-clawed otters, and Black howler monkey youngsters | Arctic foxes, sea otters, tamarin monkeys and red pandas are just some of the tiniest, cutest creatures featured in Baby Animals. With their big eyes and wobbly first steps, nature's newbies are irresistible. Watch how animals nurture their young as infant elephants, baby bison and rambunctious rhinos all eat, sleep and play their way to adulthood in their respective natural habitats. Cuddly, clumsy and full of mischief, the babies of the animal kingdom certainly make up the wildest daycare you've ever seen. Find out how it all happens

programme.title: Jaguar Journals: Badalo is Missing (S1E5). Documentary about nature. England, 2024. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2024 г. Год: 2024. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2024. S1, Ep5 «Jaguar Journals»…Watch the Onçafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Aurora's cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzie's game-changing research in jeopardy | Biologist Lizzie Daly joins forces with Oncafari, an extensive ten-year jaguar research project, on a mission to monitor, study and conserve the world's most elusive big cat: the jaguar | Director: Mark Davenport | Cast: Lizzie Daly

programme.title: Evolution Earth: Ice (S1E4). Documentary about nature. USA, 2023. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: JAV. Год: 2023. S1, Ep4 «Evolution Earth»…Trek to the planet's quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming | Evolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. Heading out across the globe to distant wilds and modern urban environments, five episodes track how animals are moving, using ingenuity to adapt their behavior, and even evolving in unexpected ways. At the front lines of this rapid change are the scientists, filmmakers and local communities recording the animals' stories. We follow heart-warming tales of resilience that redefine our understanding of evolution, and hint at how nature can show us a path towards a sustainable future for Planet Earth. The series is narrated by Dr. Shane Campbell-Staton, who guides us through each episode in an intimate narrative style, drawing on his background as an evolutionary biologist | Director: Charlotte Lathane | Cast: Shane Campbell-Staton

programme.title: Evolution Earth: Grasslands (S1E5). Documentary about nature. USA, 2023. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: JAV. Год: 2023. S1, Ep5 «Evolution Earth»…Explore one of Earth's most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet | Evolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. programme.title: The Living Beach: Australia (S1E5). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2016. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2016. S1, Ep5 «The Living Beach»…Just beyond Australia's Queensland State is Fraser Island–a complex ecosystem built entirely upon sand. Even in the middle of its rainforests, eucalyptus woodlands or mangrove forests, a visitor to Fraser Island is always standing upon the living beach | When we think of a beach, we often think of a carefree place where we can relax and do nothing. Yet for the natural world, the opposite is true – this documentary series shows us how nature is constantly at work on the world's beaches. Travelling to coastlines across the globe including Australia, Mexico and Florida, we are told how the shores have been created over time, we also learn about the diverse ecosystems and the species that call the beach home. We are shown the human impact on the beaches and the efforts being made to protect them. Narrated by Tish Iceton | Director: Josh MacDonald, Matt Trecartin | Cast: Tish Iceton

programme.title: Extreme Africa: The Southern Drylands (S1E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2016. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S1, Ep4 «Extreme Africa»…The Southern Drylands is a journey into the most arid and extreme environments in the furthest reaches of southern Africa. We go to spectacular but treacherous places where almost no rain falls, to find incredibly resilient creatures and learn the secrets to their survival. From the largest mammals to the fastest insects and even a ghost-like fish found nowhere else in the world, the Southern Drylands contain some extraordinary inhabitants, all connected by the daily challenges of living in some of most inhospitable habitats in the world | Have a look at the amazing variety of scenery and fantastic landscapes of the Dark continent. Its one-of-a-kind diverse habitats, rich flora and fauna, mountains and deserts, national parks and drylands, herds of exotic creatures in the extreme harsh conditions are overwhelming | Director: Christopher D.Z. Mason

Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming | Evolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. Heading out across the globe to distant wilds and modern urban environments, five episodes track how animals are moving, using ingenuity to adapt their behavior, and even evolving in unexpected ways. At the front lines of this rapid change are the scientists, filmmakers and local communities recording the animals' stories. We follow heart-warming tales of resilience that redefine our understanding of evolution, and hint at how nature can show us a path towards a sustainable future for Planet Earth. The series is narrated by Dr. Shane Campbell-Staton, who guides us through each episode in an intimate narrative style, drawing on his background as an evolutionary biologist | Director: Charlotte Lathane | Cast: Shane Campbell-Staton

programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2016. S1, Ep5 «The Living Beach»…Just beyond Australia's Queensland State is Fraser Island–a complex ecosystem built entirely upon sand. Even in the middle of its rainforests, eucalyptus woodlands or mangrove forests, a visitor to Fraser Island is always standing upon the living beach | When we think of a beach, we often think of a carefree place where we can relax and do nothing. Yet for the natural world, the opposite is true – this documentary series shows us how nature is constantly at work on the world's beaches. Travelling to coastlines across the globe including Australia, Mexico and Florida, we are told how the shores have been created over time, we also learn about the diverse ecosystems and the species that call the beach home. We are shown the human impact on the beaches and the efforts being made to protect them. Narrated by Tish Iceton | Director: Josh MacDonald, Matt Trecartin | Cast: Tish Iceton

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs: The Rescuers (S1E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2019. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S1, Ep1 «Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs»…In this episode, dogs are coming to our rescue in a number of surprising ways. A Great Dane shows us how he has transformed the life of a 13-year-old Massachusetts girl with a life-limiting condition. A Search and Rescue Border Collie-cross – was once on death row in an animal shelter but now he's an integral member of the California Task Force searching for survivors when earthquakes, hurricanes or deadly mudslides strike. Ruger the anti-poaching dog is on duty in Zambia detecting illegal ivory and smuggled wildlife. And, finally, A Newfoundland helps teach his German Shepherd apprentice she needs to become a water rescue dog in Italy's Lake Garda | It is often said that dogs are man's best friend but this documentary shows that they can also make excellent colleagues too. This series looks at the ways that the natural attributes of canines are being used in the world of work in all different sectors and how dogs are used to enhance and sometimes save the lives of humans. Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs travels across different continents to meet the four-legged friends who are performing key roles in crucial work. We see how dogs are integral to the work of the police, firefighters, scientists and more. Narrated by Victoria Stilwell | Director: Blake McGrow, Sean McDonnell

programme.desc: Trong nhiều thế kỷ, những câu chuyện kỳ ​​​​diệu về những con quái vật đáng sợ đã mê hoặc loài người. Những con thú kỳ quái với đủ hình dạng và kích cỡ đã được miêu tả trong một số câu chuyện và văn hóa dân gian kinh điển nhất trong lịch sử.

programme.title: NA TRA: ĐƯỜNG ĐUA RỰC LỬA - NEZHA
programme.desc: Một cựu tay đua hàng đầu muốn chứng tỏ bản thân trong một cuộc đua nhưng lại vô tình làm tổn thương đồng đội Lily, dẫn đến sự sụp đổ của đội. Khi một nhà vô địch đua xe ảo thiếu kinh nghiệm gia nhập đội và bất ngờ tỏa sáng trong một cuộc đua ngoài đời thực, liệu ba tay đua có thể hợp tác để giành lại vinh quang cho đội của mình?

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Hãy tham gia cùng các người mẫu nổi tiếng Indonesia Patricia và Chika khi họ khám phá những viên ngọc ẩn giấu và khung cảnh sôi động của thành phố, đắm mình trong sự tương phản đáng kinh ngạc và những rung cảm thời thượng.

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: ĐẶC VỤ VÔ HÌNH 2 - THE GREY MEN 2
programme.desc: Ông trùm Hội Tam Hoàng Song tìm cách xóa sạch hình ảnh của mình và chiếm lấy ghế thị trưởng của Laika trong bối cảnh chế độ đang thay đổi. Anh ta phải đối mặt với sự thiếu hụt kinh phí mặc dù đã thông đồng với các quan chức, đồng thời được cánh tay phải và người thi hành án của mình phạm tội để tăng cường quỹ và quyền lực của anh ta. Ngay khi Song tin rằng thành công sắp đến thì động lực giữa ba người lại có một bước ngoặt bất ngờ…

programme.title: ĐỊCH NHÂN KIỆT: QUỶ TRẤN U HỒN - DETECTIVE DEE: THE GHOSTS IN WEIRD TOWN
programme.desc: Thám tử Dee điều tra một loạt các biến đổi ma cà rồng đáng sợ ở Thị trấn Youming, phát hiện ra một âm mưu độc ác do Hoàng tử Li Zhen chủ mưu, người âm mưu lật đổ đế chế. Được trang bị lòng dũng cảm và sự khéo léo, Dee đánh bại lũ ma cà rồng khát máu và cuối cùng vạch trần tham vọng đen tối của hoàng tử.

programme.title: CHIẾN BINH THỰC TẾ ẢO - VR FIGHTER
programme.desc: Vệ sĩ Long Wei mắc chứng rối loạn căng thẳng sau chấn thương tâm lý sau cái chết của vợ. Một ngày nọ, anh gặp Amy, người làm việc cho một công ty công nghệ VR và được mời thử nghiệm sản phẩm mới. Sau cuộc thử nghiệm, Long Wei trở thành chiến binh VR của công ty và mặc bộ áo giáp mới được phát minh. Tuy nhiên, khi những người đàn ông có vũ trang bí ẩn đột nhập, một trận chiến khốc liệt vừa mới bắt đầu...

programme.title: GIAO KÈO BÉO BỞ - A GOOD DEAL
programme.desc: Bị bắt cóc bởi một cặp vợ chồng tuyệt vọng, doanh nhân Burks Hill buộc phải thực hiện một hành trình điên cuồng đến Los Angeles. Khi nguy hiểm ngày càng gia tăng, ba du khách phát hiện ra rằng mỗi người họ đều ẩn chứa những bí mật chết người. Những gì bắt đầu từ một vụ bắt cóc đơn giản đã biến thành một trò chơi chết chóc mà không ai có thể sống sót.
